items.title: The new and huger Paramount has a new co-CEO
items.summary: Paramount has appointed former Mattel chairman and CEO Ynon Kreiz as its new co-CEO ahead of its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Kreiz will lead alongside chairman and CEO David Ellison. Ellison is set to focus on the company's long-term strategy, creative vision, and direction.
items.blurb: Paramount is appointing a new co-CEO ahead of the close of its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Ynon Kreiz, previously Mattel's chairman and CEO, will be joining Paramount to lead alongside chairman and CEO David Ellison. items.title: The Pentagon taps Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey to help decide what the military should do next
items.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has launched a 120-day study on the future of warfare led by Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey, and Newt Gingrich. Critics note potential conflicts of interest, as Musk's and Luckey's companies already sell technologies the study is likely to recommend. The appointments come amid close ties between the leaders and the administration.
items.blurb: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth just launched a 120-day study on the future of warfare, led by Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey, and Newt Gingrich, and while it makes sense given their ties to the administration, critics could point out that Musk's and Luckey's companies already sell the kinds of technology the study is likely to recommend.

items.title: Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey will advise the government on the future of warfare
items.summary: Elon Musk and Palmer Luckey have been selected to advise the government on the future of warfare. They will be joined by Newt Gingrich in advising on military strategy.
items.blurb: So will Newt Gingrich, for some reason.

items.title: Fujifilm's Instax Pal 2 can plug directly into your smartphone to transfer images
items.summary: Fujifilm has introduced the Instax Pal 2, a small digital camera that can plug directly into a smartphone for image transfers. The device features tactile controls alongside software filters.
items.blurb: The small digital camera combines software filters with tactile controls.

items.title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
items.summary: AI startup Flow Engineering has reached a $750 million valuation with backing from Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia. The company brings AI agents to hardware design. Additionally, Roelof Botha joined as an angel investor and board member.
items.blurb: Flow Engineering, which is bringing AI agents to hardware design, also landed Roelof Botha as an angel investor and board member.

items.title: Neon sticks it to A24 by announcing a Creative Commons SCP Foundation movie
items.summary: Neon has announced an SCP Foundation movie licensed under Creative Commons following backlash against A24 from the horror community. A24 had faced criticism for announcing its own film without contacting the SCP Wiki team or committing to the required Creative Commons license. Neon aims to capitalize on the situation as a major PR win.
items.blurb: A24 pissed off one of the internet's largest horror communities when it announced it was working on an SCP Foundation film, but apparently hadn't bothered to contact the SCP Wiki team, nor did it commit to releasing it under a Creative Commons license as required. Seeing an easy PR win, Neon is cashing in by […]

items.title: Google announces Gemini 4 and says it’s so capable that only ‘trusted cyber defenders’ can have it right now
items.summary: Google has unveiled its next frontier AI model, named Gemini 4 Argon, claiming high performance in complex workflows including software engineering, enterprise tasks, and cybersecurity defense. Due to its advanced capabilities, Google is currently restricting access strictly to trusted cyber defenders. The announcement was shared by Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu.
items.blurb: Google today revealed its next AI frontier model, which it's calling Gemini 4 Argon. The new model delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense," according to chief AI architect and Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. items.title: Factory CEO just accused his VC board advisor of spying for Cognition
items.summary: The CEO of Factory has accused former board advisor Chris Degnan of spying on behalf of Cognition. Degnan, a venture capitalist, has taken on a new role as chief revenue officer at Cognition.
items.blurb: VC Chris Degnan and former board advisor to Factory AI has taken a job as chief revenue officer for Cognition.

items.title: Is Neko Health’s body scan worth it? Spotify billionaire’s startup has come to America
items.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek's startup Neko Health has expanded to America after raising $700 million to offer preventative body scanning. Other players like Midjourney and Function Health are also entering or expanding in the preventative healthcare market with significant funding. An episode of TechCrunch's Equity podcast explores why investors are placing such large bets on this category.
items.blurb: Spotify founder Daniel Ek’s Neko Health raised $700 million to build a business around scanning your body, but it’s not the only company centering its roadmap around a new kind of preventative healthcare. Midjourney is building its own body scanner, while Function Health has also raised significant capital to build out its preventative-health platform. Why are investors betting so big on this category?  On this episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, […]

items.title: Hackers stole millions of US military personnel records during months-long data breach
items.summary: The Department of Defense has informed millions of current and former U.S. military personnel that their personal information was compromised. The data theft occurred during a months-long data breach executed by hackers.
items.blurb: The Department of Defense notified millions of current and former U.S. military personnel that their personal information had been stolen in a months-long breach.
